newsitem.title: USA: MedCath's McAllen hospital had good Q1.
newsitem.headline: MedCath's McAllen hospital had good Q1.

text.p: MedCath Inc said Monday its McAllen Heart Hospital operated profitably for the first quarter ended December 31.

Stephen Puckett, president of MedCath, said that during the quarter, the average daily census at the hospital, located in McAllen, Texas, was 40, procedure volumes continued to increase, and the hospital had record net revenue and operated profitably.
In calendar 1996, the first full year of operations for the hospital, "we believe that the hospital has achieved a dominant 44 percent cardiac cath lab market share," he said.
MedCath today reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.15, with record net revenue and net income.

The company said that during the quarter each of its three operating divisions continued to expand. The divisions are performing very well and the momentum is expected to continue throughout the year, it said.

It said it had formed a venture with the Arizona Heart Institute to construct a new heart hospital in Phoenix, Ariz. To be named Arizona Heart Hospital, the venture plans to complete the hospital by spring 1998. It will be the company's sixth heart hospital project.

MedCath said its diagnostic division had opened a new cath laboratory in a joint venture with Gaston Memorial Hospital in Gastonia, N.C., bringing the number of mobile and fixed-site facilities it owns or manages to 31.
